ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling and light-colored focal spots concentrated on the distal outer lobes; solid black pigmentation concentrated at the proximal center near the peduncle and along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks along the inner trailing edge transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular structural clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slightly flatter or concave sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups located primarily on the trailing edge tips and scattered across the dark central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible diagonal light-colored linear pixel disruptions on the lower-left lobe and vertical-oriented scratch marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular structural growth and high-contrast white clustering on the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with significant biological colonization or trauma-induced scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'salt-and-pepper' transition boundary between the solid black central pigmentation and the heavily mottled white regions of the distal lobes.
